subject: Medispan: Prompt/output/log retreat — scheduling purge + evidence delivery
messages:
From: Sana Gupta <sana.gupta@medispan.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Request: full purge of prompts/outputs/logs for Medispan-Prod tenancy

Hi Karthik —

Per our contract termination, we need Redwood to execute a complete removal of all customer-provided prompts, model outputs, and inference logs tied to the Medispan-Prod tenant (tenant id: ms-prod-01). This includes any KV/cache derivatives, transient prompt traces, and application-level request logs that contain PHI.

Can you confirm:
- What exact artifacts you will delete vs what you will retain for audit purposes
- Proposed deletion window (we would prefer ASAP but need a concrete ETA)
- Proof package format (manifest, checksums, storage links) and retention of audit trail (we understand minimal logs may be necessary for compliance)

MediSpan has a signed DPA ready to attach; legal@medispan.com is on copy. This is time-sensitive for our compliance team (HIPAA).

Thanks,
Sana
Director, Cloud Ops
MediSpan
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: Sana Gupta <sana.gupta@medispan.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: full purge of prompts/outputs/logs for Medispan-Prod tenancy

Hi Sana — thanks for the note and for looping in legal.

We can run a scoped purge for ms-prod-01. High-level plan below; Laura (ops) and Rishi (security) are copied to finalize runbook and timing:

1) Scope confirmation — you approve the attached scope_manifest.csv that lists buckets, namespaces, and model variants to remove.
2) Schedule a maintenance window (preferably off-peak) — proposed: 2026-11-22 02:00 UTC.
3) Pre-run snapshot & ephemeral retention — we will take a short-lived snapshot for rollback within a 24-hour abort window, then delete snapshots after confirmation (we'll document timestamps).
4) Purge steps — delete prompt logs, derived KV caches, generated outputs, and inference request logs. System audit logs that contain only metadata (no prompt content) will be retained for 90 days for post-deletion verification; those logs will not contain prompt text or user content.
5) Evidence delivery — we will provide a deletion_manifest (csv), SHA256 checksums for removed files, and a guarded Drive folder with S3 delete manifests and job run logs.

Please confirm acceptance of the scope_manifest.csv and whether you want a DocuSign approval or an email-confirmed green light. Once we have confirmation we will queue the run.

Attachments: scope_manifest.csv (stub)

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, Sana Gupta <sana.gupta@medispan.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0500
Subject: Ops runbook: Medispan ms-prod-01 purge (draft)

Hi all —

Attached is the ops_runbook_v2.pdf (draft) that outlines the technical steps we will take. Summary below: 

• Prechecks (T-48h): confirm no active ingest pipelines, confirm DPA signed, confirm PO if required.
• Snapshot (T-2h): create temporary encrypted snapshot of prompt-index and KV shards; snapshots are tagged ms-prod-01/prepurge/{timestamp}. Snapshots are retained for 24 hours and deleted immediately after successful purge verification.
• Purge (T=0):
  - Invalidate KV cache namespaces for tenant ms-prod-01
  - Remove prompt logs and outputs from object storage (S3 path s3://redwood-prod/ms-prod-01/prompts/ and /outputs/) using inventory job that records object keys
  - Execute DB delete for request-level logs that contain prompt text (RDS delete job)
  - Rotate encryption keys for any short-lived caches per security guidance to prevent latent recovery
• Post-run evidence (T+1h): run validation to confirm zero objects matching ms-prod-01 content; generate deletion_manifest_20261122.csv and checksums file; export job logs (redacted where necessary) to guarded Drive.

We will perform the purge at the proposed window 2026-11-22 02:00 UTC pending your written approval. If you need an earlier window we can attempt but will need 24h for ops prep.

Attachments: ops_runbook_v2.pdf (attachment stub)

Laura Bennett
Head of Cloud Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Sana Gupta <sana.gupta@medispan.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: MediSpan Legal <legal@medispan.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 12:10:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Ops runbook: Medispan ms-prod-01 purge (draft)

Karthik / Laura —

Thanks for the detailed plan. MediSpan confirms the following:
- Scope in scope_manifest.csv is approved; includes prompts/outputs/logs and the three model variants listed.
- We have uploaded the signed DPA (signed_DPA_MediSpan.pdf) to the DocuSign envelope referenced earlier and have sent legal confirmation.
- Accept the proposed purge window 2026-11-22 02:00 UTC. Please proceed.

Two requests before execution:
1) Please publish the exact list of object prefixes you will delete in the evidence package (we need it for our internal auditors).
2) If you decide to retain minimal audit metadata, confirm that metadata contains no prompt content and state retention period (90 days is acceptable).

Confirm when artifacts are available so we can coordinate with our compliance team to accept the proof package.

Regards,
Sana
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: Sana Gupta <sana.gupta@medispan.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, MediSpan Legal <legal@medispan.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 04:15:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Medispan purge — completion & evidence delivery

Sana / Legal / Team —

Confirmation: purge for tenant ms-prod-01 completed at 2026-11-22T02:17:03Z (UTC) per ops runbook. Summary evidence package delivered to the guarded Drive link below and attached files included with this email.

What we deleted (high level):
- s3://redwood-prod/ms-prod-01/prompts/ (object prefixes listed in deletion_manifest_20261122.csv)
- s3://redwood-prod/ms-prod-01/outputs/
- rds://redwood-logs/ms-prod-01/request_logs/ (rows containing prompt_text)
- KV namespaces: ms-prod-01-kv-0..3

What we retained (audit metadata only):
- Job-level audit entries (timestamp, job-id, object-count) without prompt or output text. These records will be retained for 90 days and are accessible upon request; they do not contain customer content.

Attachments delivered: deletion_manifest_20261122.csv, evidence_checksums.txt. Drive: https://drive.redwood.internal/proofs/MS-4721/20261122 (guarded access).

If you would like a signed attestation PDF for your records we can produce one; alternatively we can coordinate a short review call with Ops and Security to walk through proof artifacts.

Apologies for the operational noise and thanks for coordinating cleanly — please reply to this thread to acknowledge receipt and close the request.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: deletion_manifest_20261122.csv (stub), evidence_checksums.txt (stub)
